descriptionChirho: The proper name זְאֵב (II) referring to Zeeb, one of two Midianite princes (along with Oreb) captured and killed by the Ephraimites during Gideon's campaign (Judg 7:25; 8:3; Ps 83:12; Isa 10:26). All 6 occurrences refer to this single individual, whether appearing in direct reference, with conjunction waw ('and Zeeb'), or in comparative constructions with preposition kaph ('like Zeeb'). Translated as English 'Zeeb,' Spanish 'Zeev,' Hindi 'Jeb' (जेेब), Arabic 'Zi-ib' (زِئِيب), Korean 'Seub' (스엘), Swahili 'Zeebu.'
